title: Onwards to Adventure!
overview: The girls are forced to try out a new virtual reality game created by Akashi.

title: The Power of Healing is Important.
overview: The girls experience Charybdis' healing skills, so that Dido can master them and boost her self-esteem.

title: So, This is the World of Adults...
overview: The girls want to look a bit more grown-up. Algérie, Zara and Pola arrive to help them with fashion.

title: Fight for the Prize!
overview: Royal Fortune and Golden Hind introduce the girls to the concept of fighting for treasure.

title: So In Other Words, Girl Power?
overview: The girls and Z46 work with Bremerton to achieve peak girl power - whatever that means.

title: Leave It to Laffey!
overview: Laffey will determine whether Suruga and Shimakaze are ready to show their new bunny outfits to the commander.

title: The Godlike Way to Spend a Holiday.
overview: The girls head out to the forest to find a way for the commander to relax.

title: Please Forgive My Sins...
overview: New secretary Janus meets Jervis, Implacable and the quartet to find out why the commander is late for work.

title: My Lucky Item?
overview: The girls head to the cafeteria for the daily special, but there isn't enough for everyone.

title: Let's Enjoy Some Delicious Sweets.
overview: Prinz Rupprecht and Roon join the girls for some sweets, but they need to clear some obstacles first.
